snippets.output: It is generally recommended to take losartan as prescribed by your healthcare provider. Losartan is typically administered once daily, but the specific regimen may vary depending on your condition and response to treatment.

Some studies suggest that single daily doses of losartan may not provide 24-hour blood pressure control in all patients. In such cases, splitting the dose to be taken twice daily might be considered to maintain more consistent blood pressure levels throughout the day. However, dose adjustments should only be made under the guidance of your healthcare provider.

One study found that an extended-release formulation of losartan provided better 24-hour blood pressure control compared to a single-dose formulation, suggesting that splitting doses may not always be necessary if an appropriate formulation is used.

It is important to follow your doctor's recommendations regarding dosage and timing of losartan administration to ensure optimal control of your blood pressure and to minimize the risk of adverse effects.
